description: The Statistics Division of Antigua and Barbuda publishes its 2011 Population and Housing Census as a REDATAM database on the ECLAC-CELADE webserver, where users can run frequencies, cross tabulations and area lists online. The household file records outer wall and roof material, year built, dwelling type, tenure, dwelling insurance, fuel, garbage disposal, main water and drinking water source, toilet, main source of lighting and ownership of items such as generators, water pumps and water heaters, together with fixed telephone, cable and internet access. Derived indicators flag unmet basic needs for water, sanitation, lighting and refuse collection. The geography runs from parishes to enumeration districts and blocks, so results can be produced for small areas. Format and access: free online tables, graphs and maps without registration, plus a PDF book of statistical tables and the questionnaire. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the database reflects 2011, the 2025 census was in the field at the time of reading, and some webserver dictionary pages returned errors. Simulation uses: enumeration district counts of roof and wall types for hurricane exposure and of water and lighting sources for utility planning. Related records: the ECLAC REDATAM census microdata and processing hub and the IPUMS International census microdata.
